丿.name: Slide
丿.mnemonic: One stroke sweeping down and to the left, like a kid going down a <radical>slide</radical>.

丨.name: Stick
丨.mnemonic: A single straight line standing upright. It's a <radical>stick</radical> planted in the ground.

凵.name: Container
凵.mnemonic: An open box with no lid, waiting to be filled. It's a <radical>container</radical>.

儿.name: Legs
儿.mnemonic: Two strokes walking off the bottom of a kanji. Those are <radical>legs</radical>.

卜.name: Toe
卜.mnemonic: A line with a little stub sticking out, like a <radical>toe</radical> poking out of a sock.

囗.name: Enclosure
囗.mnemonic: A big box that surrounds whatever is inside it. It's an <radical>enclosure</radical>, like a fence around a field. (Bigger than <radical>mouth</radical>, which is small and sits beside things.)

⺍.name: Sparkle
⺍.mnemonic: Three little strokes flying off the top of something, the way a cartoon draws <radical>sparkle</radical> on a shiny object.

冖.name: Lid
冖.mnemonic: A flat cover with the corners bent down. Pop it onto a pot: it's a <radical>lid</radical>.

亠.name: Top Hat
亠.mnemonic: A dot above a flat brim. That's a <radical>top hat</radical> sitting on top of the kanji.

气.name: Steam
气.mnemonic: Wavy lines rising and curling off to the side. It's <radical>steam</radical> rising from a kettle.

丆.name: Awning
丆.mnemonic: A flat roof with one side dropping down: a shop <radical>awning</radical> sticking out over the door.

亻.name: Person
亻.mnemonic: This is <kanji>人</kanji> squeezed thin to fit on the left of a kanji. Whenever you see it, a <radical>person</radical> is standing there.

彳.name: Going
彳.mnemonic: A double person on the left, one behind the other, marching along a road. They're <radical>going</radical> somewhere.

幺.name: Cocoon
幺.mnemonic: Two little twists and a tail, wound up tight. It's a silkworm <radical>cocoon</radical>.

夂.name: Winter
夂.mnemonic: This shape sits in <kanji>冬</kanji>, the kanji for winter. Picture a foot dragging slowly through snow: <radical>winter</radical>.

刂.name: Knife
刂.mnemonic: Two upright strokes on the right side. It's <kanji>刀</kanji> standing on its edge: a <radical>knife</radical>, ready to cut whatever is next to it.

冂.name: Helmet
冂.mnemonic: A tall frame with an open bottom. It's a knight's <radical>helmet</radical> seen from the front.

聿.name: Brush
聿.mnemonic: A hand gripping a long shaft with lines across it. It's a calligraphy <radical>brush</radical>.

丶.name: Drop
丶.mnemonic: A tiny single dot, like a <radical>drop</radical> of ink that fell off the brush.

𠂉.name: Gun
𠂉.mnemonic: A short stroke and a bent one, like the barrel and grip of a <radical>gun</radical> pointed sideways.

毋.name: Mother
毋.mnemonic: This is <kanji>母</kanji> with the dots merged into a line. Still a <radical>mother</radical>, just a strict one who says "don't".

𠂇.name: Hand
𠂇.mnemonic: A cross with a sweep, a <radical>hand</radical> reaching out. It's the top of <kanji>右</kanji> and <kanji>左</kanji>.

乂.name: Cross
乂.mnemonic: Two strokes crossing each other in an X. A plain <radical>cross</radical>.

龰.name: Footprint
龰.mnemonic: The bottom half of <kanji>足</kanji>, the kanji for foot. It's a <radical>footprint</radical> left behind in the mud.

宀.name: Roof
宀.mnemonic: A dot for a chimney and a cover underneath. It's a <radical>roof</radical>, and whatever sits under it is indoors.

艹.name: Grass
艹.mnemonic: Little shoots poking up at the top of the kanji. It's <radical>grass</radical>, and it usually means something about plants.

龶.name: Life
龶.mnemonic: It's <kanji>生</kanji> with the bottom trimmed off. A little sprout of <radical>life</radical> growing on top.

厶.name: Private
厶.mnemonic: A small closed loop that keeps something to itself. It's <radical>private</radical>, and none of your business.

礻.name: Altar
礻.mnemonic: This is <kanji>示</kanji> squeezed onto the left side. It's a shrine <radical>altar</radical>, and kanji with it are about gods and blessings.

也.name: Scorpion
也.mnemonic: A curled body with a tail that hooks up. A <radical>scorpion</radical>, ready to sting.

勿.name: Banner
勿.mnemonic: A pole with flowing strips hanging off it. It's a <radical>banner</radical> waving in the wind.

マ.name: Mama
マ.mnemonic: This looks exactly like the katakana マ (ma). Picture your <radical>mama</radical>.

⻌.name: Scooter
⻌.mnemonic: A long swoop along the bottom that carries the rest of the kanji on its back. Everything is riding a <radical>scooter</radical>, so kanji with it are usually about moving.

辶.name: Scooter
辶.mnemonic: The old-style form of the scooter swoop, with two dots on top. Same meaning: everything on it is on the move.

豕.name: Pig
豕.mnemonic: A fat body on short legs with a curly tail. It's a <radical>pig</radical>.

攵.name: Whip
攵.mnemonic: A hand holding a stick at an angle, ready to strike. It's a <radical>whip</radical>, and kanji with it usually involve making something happen.

耂.name: Old Man
耂.mnemonic: The top of <kanji>老</kanji>, the kanji for old. It's an <radical>old man</radical> with a walking stick.

氵.name: Water
氵.mnemonic: Three drops splashing down the left side. It's <radical>water</radical>, and kanji with it are usually wet.

广.name: Canopy
广.mnemonic: A roof with only one wall, like a big tent <radical>canopy</radical> sheltering a market stall.

冫.name: Ice
冫.mnemonic: Water has three drops. This has only two, because the third one froze. It's <radical>ice</radical>.

⺕.name: Broom
⺕.mnemonic: A hand-like shape with bristles across it. It's a <radical>broom</radical>, sweeping from side to side.

罒.name: Net
罒.mnemonic: A box with lines through it like mesh. It's a fishing <radical>net</radical> laid flat on top of the kanji.

几.name: Table
几.mnemonic: A flat top on two legs. It's a little <radical>table</radical>.

灬.name: Fire
灬.mnemonic: Four sparks along the bottom of a kanji. It's <kanji>火</kanji>, <radical>fire</radical>, burning underneath something.

𠂊.name: Hook
𠂊.mnemonic: Two little bent strokes, like a <radical>hook</radical> hanging off the top of the kanji.

巴.name: Snake
巴.mnemonic: A coiled body with its tail curling out the bottom. It's a <radical>snake</radical>, curled up in a basket.

禾.name: Grain
禾.mnemonic: A tree with the top bent over under its weight. It's a stalk of <radical>grain</radical>, heavy with rice.

隹.name: Turkey
隹.mnemonic: A bird with lots of little lines for feathers. It's a fat <radical>turkey</radical>.

亅.name: Barb
亅.mnemonic: A downward stroke that flicks up at the end, like the <radical>barb</radical> on a fishing hook.

癶.name: Tent
癶.mnemonic: Two sides spreading apart like a <radical>tent</radical> being pitched with its flaps open.

弋.name: Ceremony
弋.mnemonic: A stake with a ribbon tied to it, planted for a <radical>ceremony</radical>. (It's the part of <kanji>式</kanji> that isn't <radical>craft</radical>.)

頁.name: Head
頁.mnemonic: A shell on legs with a big face on top. It shows up in kanji about the face and head, like <kanji>顔</kanji> and <kanji>頭</kanji>, so call it <radical>head</radical>. (Also used for pages.)

扌.name: Fingers
扌.mnemonic: This is <kanji>手</kanji> squeezed onto the left. Kanji with it are done with your <radical>fingers</radical>: hold, throw, hit, fold.

⻖.name: Building
⻖.mnemonic: A big 'B' on the left side of a kanji. B for <radical>building</radical>.

⻏.name: Town
⻏.mnemonic: The same 'B' shape as building, but on the right side. It's a whole <radical>town</radical> down the road.

歹.name: Bones
歹.mnemonic: A skeleton lying down. It's a pile of <radical>bones</radical>, and kanji with it are usually about death.

匕.name: Spoon
匕.mnemonic: A handle with a curved bowl on the bottom. It's a <radical>spoon</radical>.

疒.name: Sick
疒.mnemonic: A canopy with a hospital bed and two drops of sweat beside it. Someone is <radical>sick</radical>.

艮.name: Root
艮.mnemonic: A shape stubbornly planted in place, like the <radical>root</radical> of a tree that won't come out. (It's the right side of <kanji>根</kanji>.)

匸.name: Hiding
匸.mnemonic: A box with the right side missing, and something tucked inside. It's <radical>hiding</radical> in there.

飠.name: Eat
飠.mnemonic: This is <kanji>食</kanji> squeezed onto the left. Kanji with it are about food and eating, so it's <radical>eat</radical>.

尸.name: Flag
尸.mnemonic: A pole with a flag hanging off the top of it. It's a <radical>flag</radical>.

卩.name: Stamp
卩.mnemonic: A shape that looks like someone kneeling, pressing down hard. It's a seal <radical>stamp</radical>.

勹.name: Wrap
勹.mnemonic: An arm curling around whatever is underneath it, to <radical>wrap</radical> it up.

廴.name: Stretch
廴.mnemonic: A long swoop along the bottom, pulled out further than it should go. It's a big <radical>stretch</radical>.

⺌.name: Triceratops
⺌.mnemonic: Three horns sticking out of the top of the kanji. It's a <radical>triceratops</radical>.

厂.name: Cliff
厂.mnemonic: A flat top with a steep side dropping straight down. It's a <radical>cliff</radical>.

釆.name: Sort
釆.mnemonic: Rice grains with a claw above, picking them apart. It's the claw that helps you <radical>sort</radical> things out.

彡.name: Hair
彡.mnemonic: Three slanted strokes, like strands of <radical>hair</radical> blowing to the side.

疋.name: Coat Rack
疋.mnemonic: A stand with a leg sticking out at the bottom. It's a <radical>coat rack</radical>.

⺤.name: Claw
⺤.mnemonic: Three strokes reaching down from the top, like a <radical>claw</radical> ready to grab.

戈.name: Halberd
戈.mnemonic: A long pole with a blade across it and a tassel. It's a <radical>halberd</radical>, a weapon.

殳.name: Weapon
殳.mnemonic: A hand at the bottom holding up something heavy. It's a club, a <radical>weapon</radical>.

氺.name: Splash
氺.mnemonic: <kanji>水</kanji> with the drops knocked loose. It's a <radical>splash</radical> of water.

酉.name: Sake
酉.mnemonic: A jar with a line through the middle marking how full it is. It's a jar of <radical>sake</radical>.

⺷.name: Sheep
⺷.mnemonic: <kanji>羊</kanji> with its tail cut off so something else can sit underneath. Still a <radical>sheep</radical>.

䒑.name: Horns
䒑.mnemonic: Two little points sticking up above a line: a pair of <radical>horns</radical>.

廾.name: Clasped Hands
廾.mnemonic: Two hands pressed together at the bottom of a kanji, lifting whatever sits on top. They're <radical>clasped hands</radical>.

覀.name: West
覀.mnemonic: The top of <kanji>西</kanji> (west), used as a lid on other kanji. Think of it as the <radical>west</radical>.

衤.name: Clothes
衤.mnemonic: This is <kanji>衣</kanji> squeezed onto the left side. It's <radical>clothes</radical>.

忄.name: Feelings
忄.mnemonic: This is <kanji>心</kanji> (heart) standing up to fit on the left side. Kanji with it are about <radical>feelings</radical>.

⺦.name: Bed
⺦.mnemonic: A shape on its side like a bed seen from the end. It's a <radical>bed</radical>.

⺨.name: Animal
⺨.mnemonic: A beast with its claws out, crouched on the left. It's an <radical>animal</radical>.

㔾.name: Crouch
㔾.mnemonic: A figure bent in half, knees up. It's someone in a <radical>crouch</radical>.

㐄.name: Steps
㐄.mnemonic: Short strokes stacked like the <radical>steps</radical> of a staircase going down.

韋.name: Leather
韋.mnemonic: Something stretched out tight from both ends, pulled in two directions. It's tanned <radical>leather</radical>.

舛.name: Dance
舛.mnemonic: Two feet pointing in different directions, mid-step. It's a <radical>dance</radical>.

彑.name: Pig Head
彑.mnemonic: A snout and a flat top, it's a <radical>pig head</radical>.

习.name: Wing
习.mnemonic: A single feather folded over. It's one half of <kanji>羽</kanji>: a <radical>wing</radical>.

龷.name: Stand
龷.mnemonic: Two posts joined on a crossbar, like a market <radical>stand</radical>.

辰.name: Dragon
辰.mnemonic: This was the sign for the dragon in the old zodiac. Call it <radical>dragon</radical>.

廿.name: Twenty
廿.mnemonic: Two tens stuck together and closed at the bottom. It's <radical>twenty</radical>.

屮.name: Sprout
屮.mnemonic: A stem with a leaf on each side, just poking out of the ground. It's a <radical>sprout</radical>.

耒.name: Plow
耒.mnemonic: A wooden tool with prongs, dragged through a field. It's a <radical>plow</radical>.

业.name: Business
业.mnemonic: The top of <kanji>業</kanji>. Think of it as <radical>business</radical>.

虍.name: Tiger
虍.mnemonic: The top of <kanji>虎</kanji>, the stripes and the snarl. It's a <radical>tiger</radical>.

卯.name: Rabbit
卯.mnemonic: Two long ears side by side. It's a <radical>rabbit</radical> from the old zodiac.

隶.name: Slave
隶.mnemonic: A hand grabbing something by the tail and not letting go. It's a <radical>slave</radical> being caught.

𦥑.name: Two Hands
𦥑.mnemonic: Two cupped hands on either side, lifting something up together. It's <radical>two hands</radical>.

巛.name: River
巛.mnemonic: Three wavy lines flowing side by side. It's a <radical>river</radical>.

巜.name: Stream
巜.mnemonic: Two wavy lines flowing side by side. It's a small <radical>stream</radical>.

尤.name: Especially
尤.mnemonic: A big person with a hook sticking out of their side. It stands out, <radical>especially</radical>.

乡.name: Countryside
乡.mnemonic: A twisting little path through the fields. It's the <radical>countryside</radical>.

𧘇.name: Robe
𧘇.mnemonic: The bottom half of <kanji>衣</kanji> hanging down. It's a long <radical>robe</radical>.

鬲.name: Cauldron
鬲.mnemonic: A pot on three legs with the steam rising off it. It's a <radical>cauldron</radical>.

乃.name: Fishhook
乃.mnemonic: A bent line that hooks back on itself. It's a <radical>fishhook</radical>.

而.name: Beard
而.mnemonic: A face with long strands hanging down underneath. It's a <radical>beard</radical>.

旡.name: Choke
旡.mnemonic: Someone bent over with their mouth open, choking. It's <radical>choke</radical>.

龍.name: Dragon King
龍.mnemonic: The full old-style dragon, scales and all. It's the <radical>dragon king</radical>.

豸.name: Badger
豸.mnemonic: A long, low beast with a hunched back. It's a <radical>badger</radical>.

瓜.name: Melon
瓜.mnemonic: A vine with a round fruit hanging off it. It's a <radical>melon</radical>.

⺗.name: Heart
⺗.mnemonic: This is <kanji>心</kanji> flattened to fit on the bottom. It's the <radical>heart</radical>.

丂.name: Snake Tongue
丂.mnemonic: A line with a forked hook under it, like a <radical>snake tongue</radical> flicking out.

匚.name: Box
匚.mnemonic: A box lying on its side, open on the right. It's a <radical>box</radical>.

⻞.name: Eat
⻞.mnemonic: The squeezed-in form of <kanji>食</kanji> used on the left. It's <radical>eat</radical>.

爻.name: Crossing
爻.mnemonic: Two X's stacked on each other. It's a double <radical>crossing</radical>.

鬯.name: Herbs
鬯.mnemonic: A pot filled with fragrant things and a spoon on the bottom. It's a pot of <radical>herbs</radical>.

一.name: Ground
一.mnemonic: A single flat line, like the horizon. As a kanji it means <kanji>one</kanji>; as a radical, think of it as the <radical>ground</radical>.

口.name: Mouth
口.mnemonic: A little square, open like a <radical>mouth</radical>.

日.name: Sun
日.mnemonic: A box with a line through the middle. It's the <radical>sun</radical>, which also means day.

月.name: Moon
月.mnemonic: Tall and with lines inside, like a crescent <radical>moon</radical>. On the side of a kanji it often means a body part (flesh).

十.name: Cross
十.mnemonic: A plus sign. As a kanji it's <kanji>ten</kanji>; as a radical, just a <radical>cross</radical>.

又.name: Stool
又.mnemonic: A flat seat on crossed legs. It's a folding <radical>stool</radical>.

寸.name: Glue
寸.mnemonic: A hook with a drop of something sticky beside it. It's <radical>glue</radical>.

工.name: Craft
工.mnemonic: An I-beam, used in building things. It's <radical>craft</radical>.

大.name: Big
大.mnemonic: A person with arms stretched as wide as they go, showing how <radical>big</radical> the fish was.

土.name: Dirt
土.mnemonic: A cross stuck in a wider line of ground. It's <radical>dirt</radical>.

士.name: Samurai
士.mnemonic: Like dirt, but the top line is the longer one: a proud <radical>samurai</radical> standing tall.

田.name: Rice Paddy
田.mnemonic: A field divided into four squares. It's a <radical>rice paddy</radical>.

禸.name: Track
禸.mnemonic: A <radical>track</radical> left behind in the dirt.

心.name: Heart
心.mnemonic: A curve with three beats around it. It's the <radical>heart</radical>.

王.name: King
王.mnemonic: Three lines joined in the middle. It's a <radical>king</radical> (and in many kanji, a jewel).

貝.name: Shell
貝.mnemonic: An eye on two little legs. It's a clam <radical>shell</radical>, which people once used as money.

見.name: See
見.mnemonic: An eye on legs, walking around. It's out to <radical>see</radical> things.

糸.name: Thread
糸.mnemonic: A twist of thread on top and loose strands at the bottom. It's <radical>thread</radical>.

言.name: Say
言.mnemonic: Lines of speech coming out of a mouth. It's <radical>say</radical>.

金.name: Gold
金.mnemonic: A roof over nuggets in the ground. It's <radical>gold</radical>, and kanji with it are about metal.

門.name: Gate
門.mnemonic: Two doors swinging open. It's a <radical>gate</radical>.

雨.name: Rain
雨.mnemonic: A sky with drops falling out of it. It's <radical>rain</radical>.

食.name: Eat
食.mnemonic: A lid over a bowl of food. It's <radical>eat</radical>.

竹.name: Bamboo
竹.mnemonic: Two stalks side by side with leaves at the top. It's <radical>bamboo</radical>.

米.name: Rice
米.mnemonic: Grains scattered in every direction. It's <radical>rice</radical>.

羊.name: Sheep
羊.mnemonic: Two horns on top and a woolly body. It's a <radical>sheep</radical>.

目.name: Eye
目.mnemonic: An eye turned on its side. It's an <radical>eye</radical>.

木.name: Tree
木.mnemonic: A trunk with branches on top and roots on the bottom. It's a <radical>tree</radical>.

水.name: Water
水.mnemonic: A stream with drops splashing off each side. It's <radical>water</radical>.

火.name: Fire
火.mnemonic: A person with sparks flying off both sides. It's <radical>fire</radical>.

女.name: Woman
女.mnemonic: A figure with crossed legs, sitting gracefully. It's a <radical>woman</radical>.

子.name: Child
子.mnemonic: A baby wrapped up with its arms sticking out. It's a <radical>child</radical>.

刀.name: Sword
刀.mnemonic: A blade with a curved hilt. It's a <radical>sword</radical>.

石.name: Stone
石.mnemonic: A mouth-shaped rock under a cliff. It's a <radical>stone</radical>.

山.name: Mountain
山.mnemonic: Three peaks, the middle one tallest. It's a <radical>mountain</radical>.

川.name: River
川.mnemonic: Three lines flowing down. It's a <radical>river</radical>.

小.name: Small
小.mnemonic: A little stick with two crumbs beside it. It's <radical>small</radical>.

立.name: Stand
立.mnemonic: A person with a hat on standing on the ground. They <radical>stand</radical>.

白.name: White
白.mnemonic: The sun with a ray of light on top. It's <radical>white</radical>.

止.name: Stop
止.mnemonic: A foot planted firmly on the ground. It's <radical>stop</radical>.

生.name: Life
生.mnemonic: A sprout growing out of the ground. It's <radical>life</radical>.

夕.name: Evening
夕.mnemonic: A crescent moon just coming up. It's <radical>evening</radical>.

方.name: Direction
方.mnemonic: A person with a hat pointing the way. It's <radical>direction</radical>.

青.name: Blue
青.mnemonic: Life on top of the moon. Looking back at Earth, everything is <radical>blue</radical>.

示.name: Show
示.mnemonic: An altar with offerings dripping off it. It's there to <radical>show</radical> the gods.

衣.name: Clothes
衣.mnemonic: A top hat over a long robe. It's <radical>clothes</radical>.

舌.name: Tongue
舌.mnemonic: Something sticking out of a mouth. It's a <radical>tongue</radical>.

巾.name: Towel
巾.mnemonic: A cloth hanging on a hook. It's a <radical>towel</radical>.

弓.name: Bow
弓.mnemonic: A curved line bent tight, ready to fire. It's a <radical>bow</radical>.

矢.name: Arrow
矢.mnemonic: A shaft with fletching on the end. It's an <radical>arrow</radical>.

斤.name: Axe
斤.mnemonic: A blade on a long handle. It's an <radical>axe</radical>.

欠.name: Yawn
欠.mnemonic: A person with their mouth wide open. It's a <radical>yawn</radical>.

皿.name: Plate
皿.mnemonic: A dish with little dividers on it. It's a <radical>plate</radical>.

羽.name: Feathers
羽.mnemonic: Two wings side by side. It's <radical>feathers</radical>.

耳.name: Ear
耳.mnemonic: An ear with the lines of the lobe drawn in. It's an <radical>ear</radical>.

肉.name: Meat
肉.mnemonic: A cut of meat with the grain showing. It's <radical>meat</radical>.

自.name: Self
自.mnemonic: A nose on a face, pointing at yourself. It's <radical>self</radical>.

至.name: Arrive
至.mnemonic: An arrow hitting the ground. It's <radical>arrive</radical>.

臼.name: Mortar
臼.mnemonic: A bowl for pounding rice. It's a <radical>mortar</radical>.

舟.name: Boat
舟.mnemonic: A little vessel with things piled in it. It's a <radical>boat</radical>.

虫.name: Insect
虫.mnemonic: A bug with a big body. It's an <radical>insect</radical>.

血.name: Blood
血.mnemonic: A plate with a drop falling into it. It's <radical>blood</radical>.

行.name: Go
行.mnemonic: A crossroads with people on both sides. It's <radical>go</radical>.

角.name: Horn
角.mnemonic: A long pointy shape with lines across. It's a <radical>horn</radical>.

谷.name: Valley
谷.mnemonic: Mountains opening up above a mouth. It's a <radical>valley</radical>.

豆.name: Bean
豆.mnemonic: A bowl on a stand with a lid. It's full of <radical>beans</radical>.

赤.name: Red
赤.mnemonic: Dirt on top of fire. It glows <radical>red</radical>.

走.name: Run
走.mnemonic: Dirt kicked up by a foot. It's <radical>run</radical>.
